name: call-the-line
description: Tennis line-judge reflex game. One HTML page, deployed to the web and wrapped for iOS and Android with Capacitor.

scripts.build:crazygames: node scripts/build.mjs && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/call-the-line-crazygames.zip && cd www && zip -qr -X ../dist/call-the-line-crazygames.zip . -x '.*' '*/.*' && cd .. && unzip -l dist/call-the-line-crazygames.zip
scripts.cap:add: npx cap add ios && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
